accepted_scope: Arbitrary unital associative real algebra, retaining noncommutative multiplication.
Native integer eigenspaces, internal direct sum, graded multiplication and algebra equivalence.
Actual sum-degree homogeneous superbrackets and unrestricted integer super-Jacobi.
Lagrange polynomial aeval identification before invariant-submodule and Lie-subalgebra restriction.
Strict kernel and dual-kernel statements about nonzero actual Module.End operators.
Constructed extreme Jordan pair with outer and fundamental identities, double-commutator agreement and separate additivity/scalar-linearity laws.
Exact ordinary and Krein skew-invariance criteria; explicit obstruction to ordinary-skew superclosure.
Actual Krein block readbacks under the stated fundamental-symmetry hypotheses.
Odd-anticommutator spans equal native finite-sum corner-submodule products.
Genuine algebra-automorphism and unit-conjugation grade transport, with cancellation grouped by total degree.
Correct quartic defect with coefficient 12 and no unconditional nonvanishing claim.
material_boundaries: The quintic is an annihilating polynomial; missing grades and a zero extreme Jordan pair are allowed.
Krein skewness is sufficient for the stated invariance, not a classification or nontriviality theorem.
The JordanPair bundle lacks trilinearity fields, but this construction separately proves all six shared add/smul laws.
Dual product equations are sufficient for kernel isolation, not necessary.
The corner-span criterion is neither single-anticommutator surjectivity nor global Morita equivalence.
Full centralizer-normalizer classification, prescribed gauge/conformal identifications and unbounded state-specific Stone/Tomita/KMS construction are not asserted.

proof_delta_reviews.changes: One explicit Module.End action lambda and three explicit (T := S) argument applications; theorem statements and hypotheses unchanged.
